title: Importer: encode cube-of-force duration as a timer transition
description: The committed dnd5e-srd-5.1 cube-of-force magic-item stateMachine declares duration {amount:1,unit:minute} and prose termination, but declares no timer transition from its face states. The item reset/timer executor therefore fails closed and deliberately does not schedule or execute this duration. Update the frozen importer/output only with source-backed evidence, add the timer transition semantics, regenerate/audit the rules pack, and preserve the executor's fail-closed behavior until then.
notes:
Discovered while implementing eshyra-pukl item reset/timer executor. Do not work around this in runtime code.
Implemented in PR #466 (branch eshyra-0p7c, commit fc15b82). Curated M5 spec now declares face-N -> inactive timers of 1 minute, anchored to the SRD 'lasts for 1 minute' and 'resetting the duration' phrases; pack regenerated, verify:dnd5e-srd-pack byte-identical. Also fixed a latent executor defect the new data exposed (applyDueTimer called sameDuration on an undefined timer declaration when a state pair carried both an operation transition and a timer). Follow-up eshyra-jw56 filed for timer re-anchoring on transitions that do not restate the duration. Left in_progress pending PR review.
close_reason: Merged to main as PR #466 (merge commit b49020c). Cube-of-force barrier duration now encoded as five face-N -> inactive one-minute timer transitions, source-anchored to 'lasts for 1 minute' and 'resetting the duration'. Pack regenerated byte-identically; pack-wide invariant added; latent applyDueTimer defect fixed. Follow-up eshyra-jw56 remains open.
